title: real button with type space vs enter
name: Real button with type; Space vs Enter — USWDS
rule: Use a real `<button>` with `type` set (`submit` / `button` / `reset`; default is submit). Do not use `<a>` or `<div>` as the only control. Space triggers a button; Enter triggers a link — do not style links as buttons without that difference.
pass_when: The control is `<button>` with an explicit `type`. Links are not styled as the only button control.
fail_when: `<a>` or `<div>` is the only control, or `type` is omitted on a non-submit button so it submits.
overview: Actions use a real button element with an explicit type; links are not the only button control.
apply_when: Implementing clickable actions that submit, reset, or run in-page commands.
not_when: Anchor navigation that should remain a real link, not a faux button.
agent_hint: Use <button> with explicit type; do not make <a> or <div> the only button control.
description: USWDS requires a real `<button>` with `type` set to `submit`, `button`, or `reset` (default is submit). Do not use `<a>` or `<div>` as the only control. Space triggers a button; Enter triggers a link—do not style links as buttons without that difference. Omitting `type` on a non-submit button so it submits, or relying on an anchor/div as the sole control, fails.
